characters.description: En rolig og godtroende bonde som stadig bytter til det han tror er noe bedre, og som stoler fullt og helt på at kona vil forstå ham.
characters.look: A short, round, easy-going farmer of about sixty with a round belly, a shiny bald head, fluffy white side-whiskers from his ears down to his jaw, a clean-shaven chin, a big pink nose, small merry blue eyes and a calm, contented smile. He wears a soft dark-green felt hat with a narrow brim, a thick knitted jacket with a black-and-white snowflake pattern and pewter clasps, brown breeches, grey wool stockings and heavy boots, and always has a short curved wooden pipe.

characters.name: Kona
characters.description: Gudbrands usedvanlig støttende kone som alltid finner en god grunn til å være fornøyd, uansett hva han har gjort.
characters.look: A plump, cheerful farm wife of about fifty, a little shorter than Gudbrand, with a round, beaming face, rosy cheeks, a broad, freckled nose, merry hazel eyes that crinkle when she laughs and grey hair pinned up in a neat bun. She wears a long rose-red wool dress with a white linen collar and rolled-up sleeves, a bright cornflower-blue apron tied with a big bow at the back, and a cream knitted shawl round her shoulders.

characters.name: Nabomannen
characters.description: En skeptisk nabo som tror Gudbrand vil få kjeft hjemme, og som ender med å tape veddemålet.
characters.look: A nosy, pot-bellied farmer of about fifty with a round, clean-shaven face, a long, pointed, twitchy nose, narrow doubtful eyes with one eyebrow always raised, big pink ears that stick straight out and short, spiky ginger hair. He wears a patched mustard-brown wool jacket with a sheepskin collar, a round brown felt hat, grey breeches and tall, scuffed boots.

places.name: the Hillside Farm
places.look: A tiny farm high on a steep hillside: a low, dark-brown log cottage with a thick turf roof growing grass and wild flowers, a stone chimney, two small four-paned windows and a sturdy plank door painted dusky blue, with a little cowshed beside it. places.name: the Cottage Room
places.look: A snug, low-ceilinged log room with honey-brown timber walls. In one corner a whitewashed stone fireplace holds a crackling fire and a black iron pot. A long, scrubbed plank table with two benches stands under a small four-paned window, beside a big wooden chest with iron bands. There is a tall cupboard painted with red-and-blue rosemaling, a shelf of wooden bowls, pegs with coats and hats, and a dusky-blue plank door with an iron latch.
